messages:
tina-sales: Vendormap (POC with large retail partner) submitted a formal request: onboard 'mistral-mini-quant' and pin v1.2 across EU + APAC. Needs int8 quantized artifact, KMS for keys, audit logs, and a 99.9% SLA. Target go-live: 6 weeks. Estimated peak 2k qps. Can we scope this? :eyes:

intake-bot: New intake ticket #INC-2026 created. Attachments: sales brief + SAML requirements.

ashley-product: Thanks Tina. We need to confirm: is the pinning mandatory to exact v1.2 or would a semver range be acceptable? Also clarify whether they'd accept Dedicated vs Hosted. @tina-sales

tina-sales: Customer insists on exact v1.2 pin for reproducibility. Dedicated is preferred for SLA + data isolation. They will sign committed capacity.

leo-eng-ml: Quick feasibility notes: mistral-mini-quant (8-bit) compiles but we need to validate kernel support on A100 and T4. Perf will vary; int8 has some accuracy delta — need evals on their prompt set. Estimated eng effort: 2-3w to generate quant artifacts + validation harness.

peter-eng-platform: On Dedicated side, autoscaling for 2k peak QPS with 100 QPS baseline — we'll need planning for burst pool and capacity reservation. Also KMS + audit logs add infra work (~1w).

maya-ops: Can we meet 99.9% SLA for inference at that QPS? Depends on redundancy across AZs/regions and node sizing. Need health checks and automated fallback policy. Canary rollout recommended.

ashley-product: Proposed plan:
- Week 0-1: confirm model artifacts & KMS scope
- Week 1-3: quantization + evals
- Week 3-4: infra + dedicated capacity provisioning
- Week 4-5: canary in EU then APAC
- Week 6: full rollout and SLO signoff

Acceptance criteria (to include in product backlog item):
- Pin v1.2 deployed and verified
- p95 latency <= 120ms for customer's test prompts (measure on dedicated infra)
- Accuracy regression <= 2% on customer's eval set
- KMS integration + audit logs enabled and reviewed
- Deployment automated via onboarding workflow + canary/fallback configured

tina-sales: Customer will provide test prompts and target 120ms p95. They also want an opt-in fallback to a cheaper model when capacity constrained.

leo-eng-ml: Fallback is doable; we need a compatibility mapping (input/output schema). Also note: fallback model must use the same tokenizer family to avoid tokenization drift.

peter-eng-platform: Action items:
- @leo-eng-ml: generate quant artifact and perf profile
- @maya-ops: estimate node counts for peak/baseline + redundancy
- @ashley-product: draft acceptance criteria and customer-facing rollout timeline
- @tina-sales: confirm contract timelines and committed capacity

intake-bot: Assigned to product triage queue. ETA: triage meeting tomorrow 10:00am PT.

ashley-product: Adding backlog ticket PROD-4182 and linking the sales brief and contract stub. Will add rollout checklist and tests.

tina-sales: Thanks all. I'll push contract details and the customer's test prompts into PROD-4182.

leo-eng-ml: FYI here's a quick config snippet I'll use for perf runs:
```
model: mistral-mini-quant
version: v1.2
quant: int8
regions: ["eu-west-1","ap-southeast-1"]
max_batch_tokens: 2048
```

maya-ops: Noted. I'll run capacity calc once perf profile is in.

ashley-product: Great. We'll reconvene after the triage meeting and lock scope. :thumbsup:
